title: Mixed Event — Nocturne Interlude — Episode6 Words That Lift Me Up

meta.Episode: Episode6 — Words That Lift Me Up
meta.Event Outline: Toya has decided to create street music as a member of Vivid BAD SQUAD. But something happens to make him wonder if classical music still has some hold on him, leading to some self-doubt...

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You gonna talk to your dad again tonight?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I intend to. It's better to do it while I've built up the courage to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just hope he finally understands this time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I understand...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I understand how stupidly deep your love of music is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When I first found out your reason for singing back then, it sounded so ridiculous that I almost snapped at you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But after hearing you sing, I realized how serious you were about music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Besides, think about it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After being immersed in music every waking hour of your life, you wouldn't touch it for the rest of your life if you really wanted to get away from it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But what you did is different, Toya. You chose to get back into music again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really gotta love music to do that, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What I'm trying to say is... Don't ever forget that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sigh...
I don't know how else to put it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I get it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll never forget how well you understand me, Akito. Not ever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Got it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Now, go home and sock it to your dad.
And don't stop until you're satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I will.
Aoyagi Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad should be home soon.)
se_event_nocturne_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
I'm home.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It's rare to see you home at this hour.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad...can we talk?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, what's this all of a sudden?
Have you finally realized the error of your ways?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Then there's nothing to talk about...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Please, listen to me.
I need to discuss this with you, dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Not backing down so easily today, eh? No matter. I am not about to change my mind...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad, I love classical music...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be honest, life hasn't been easy for me because of how strict you've always been. However...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You also taught me how great classical music can be.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How different fingering techniques produced different sounds, or how to discern why a composer made a score and where they were coming from... It was exciting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Above all, I love the way you play the piano.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wished that I could play as confidently and elegantly as you.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Then why...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At first, it was just like you said. I wanted to run away.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't bear the stress of practicing so hard every day. I just wanted to rebel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I picked the music genre I thought you would hate the most...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
I thought as much...
I figured it was something foolish like that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But then I met some friends who showed me the music I truly wanted to play.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And the more I sang, the more I came to love street music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is a ticket to our next event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please come and listen to my resolve with your own ears.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Hearing something like this isn't going to...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I know it may seem it's beneath you.
But that's not how I see it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This music is as important to me as classical music is to you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've never wanted to hold on to something so much before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I really want you to understand that... Because you're the one who introduced me to the joy of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be waiting for you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And... Thank you very much for teaching me classical music all these years.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If it weren't for you, I would never have met Akito and the others, or even found my dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So... Thank you, dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's all I wanted to say. Good night...
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I said everything that I needed to.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now to focus on giving tomorrow everything I've got...)
